title: Medical AI, LLM & Multimodal Benchmarks
blurb: Datasets built to train or evaluate medical AI: clinical QA and reasoning, report generation, error detection, safety and bias tests, and image–text corpora.

items.name: HealthBench Professional
items.description: 525 physician-authored clinician tasks with rubrics for evaluating how well LLMs support professional clinical work.

items.name: MedVAL-Bench
items.description: 840 AI-generated medical texts (reports, summaries, notes) graded by physicians for factual errors and patient-safety risk.

items.name: VITA HealthBench datasets
items.description: Questions, model responses and rubric scores used to benchmark health AI systems: 500 questions across five systems plus 4,023 English-language questions.

items.name: MedAgentBench
items.description: 300 physician-written clinical tasks in a simulated FHIR-based EHR environment for benchmarking LLM agents that act on patient records.

paper.label: Jiang Y et al. arXiv 2025

items.name: MedAlign
items.description: 983 clinician-written instructions over 276 longitudinal EHRs with 303 reference responses, for evaluating LLMs on real EHR tasks.
items.access_note: Instructions public; EHR data via Stanford Redivis with a research data use agreement.

paper.label: Fleming SL et al. AAAI 2024

items.name: EHRSHOT
items.description: Longitudinal structured EHR data for 6,739 Stanford patients with 15 few-shot prediction tasks, released with a pretrained foundation model.
items.access_note: Free research access via Stanford Redivis after accepting the data use agreement.

paper.label: Wornow M et al. NeurIPS 2023 Datasets & Benchmarks

items.name: MIMIC-IV-Ext-MedicalBench
items.description: 405 MIMIC-IV-derived examples for benchmarking extraction of ICD-10 diagnosis concepts from clinical text.

items.name: ArchEHR-QA
items.description: Patient questions paired with clinician-rewritten questions and grounding EHR note excerpts, from the BioNLP 2025 shared task on answering patient questions from records.

items.name: VeriFact-BHC
items.description: 13,070 propositions from human- and LLM-written brief hospital courses (MIMIC-III) annotated for factual support against the EHR.

items.name: FactEHR
items.description: 2,168 clinical notes from four types with LLM fact decompositions and entailment labels for evaluating factuality in clinical text.
items.access_note: Built on MIMIC/PhysioNet notes; access through PhysioNet credentialing.

paper.label: Munnangi M et al. arXiv 2024

items.name: MEDEC
items.description: 3,848 clinical texts with injected or real medical errors for benchmarking error detection and correction by LLMs (MEDIQA-CORR 2024).

paper.label: Ben Abacha A et al. arXiv 2024

items.name: ACI-Bench
items.description: Ambient Clinical Intelligence benchmark: 207 doctor–patient conversation transcripts paired with visit notes for note-generation research.
items.access_note: Direct download from figshare / GitHub (CC BY 4.0).

paper.label: Yim W et al. Sci Data 2023;10:586

items.name: MTS-Dialog
items.description: 1,700 short doctor–patient conversations with corresponding summaries (clinical note sections) for dialogue summarisation.

paper.label: Ben Abacha A et al. EACL 2023

items.name: PriMock57
items.description: 57 mock primary-care consultations with audio, transcripts and clinician-written notes for speech recognition and note generation.

paper.label: Korfiatis AP et al. ACL 2022

items.name: PMC-Patients
items.description: ~167,000 patient summaries extracted from PubMed Central case reports with patient–article and patient–patient relevance labels for retrieval tasks.
items.access_note: Direct download from figshare / Hugging Face.

paper.label: Zhao Z et al. Sci Data 2023;10:909

items.name: MultiCaRe
items.description: Multimodal case-report dataset from PubMed Central: 75,382 articles, 96,428 cases and 135,596 images with captions and labels.

items.name: NHS England Synthetic Clinical Notes
items.description: Synthetic clinical notes for 70 fictional patients, released by NHS England for safe NLP development.

items.name: EkaCare Medical Public Datasets
items.description: Collection of Indian clinical datasets for medical speech recognition, health-record parsing and clinical note generation.
items.access_note: Hugging Face collection; some sets require accepting terms.

items.name: Cardiac Investigations Text (AMIE)
items.description: Cardiology test reports (ECG, echo, Holter, CMR, CPET) released with Google's AMIE cardiology study.

items.name: PARROT
items.description: 2,658 fictional radiology reports written by radiologists in 14 languages, for multilingual radiology NLP.

items.name: RadGraph & RadGraph2
items.description: Radiologist-annotated entities and relations in chest X-ray reports (RadGraph: 500 reports; RadGraph2 adds change-over-time relations), plus large auto-annotated sets.

paper.label: Jain S et al. NeurIPS 2021 Datasets & Benchmarks

items.name: RadEvalX
items.description: Radiologist annotations of clinically significant errors in 100 AI-generated chest X-ray reports.

items.name: ReXErr-v1
items.description: Clinically meaningful synthetic errors injected into MIMIC-CXR reports for training and evaluating report-error detection.

items.name: Chest ImaGenome
items.description: Scene graphs linking anatomy, findings and comparisons for MIMIC-CXR images, with a 500-patient gold standard.

items.name: REFLACX
items.description: Eye-tracking data, dictated reports and abnormality ellipses from radiologists reading 3,032 MIMIC-CXR chest X-rays.
items.access_note: Free PhysioNet account + signed data use agreement.

paper.label: Bigolin Lanfredi R et al. Sci Data 2022;9:350

items.name: Eye Gaze Data for Chest X-rays (EGD-CXR)
items.description: Eye-tracking and report dictation from a radiologist reading 1,083 MIMIC-CXR images.

paper.label: Karargyris A et al. Sci Data 2021;8:92

items.name: CheXthought
items.description: Radiologist think-aloud reasoning traces and eye-tracking recorded while interpreting chest X-rays.
items.access_note: Free; request access on Stanford Redivis.

items.name: Collab-CXR
items.description: Experimental data from 227 radiologists reading chest X-rays with and without AI assistance, for studying human–AI collaboration.

items.name: LLaVA-Rad training data
items.description: 697,000 radiology image–text pairs (400,042 chest X-ray pairs) assembled from public sources to train a small multimodal radiology model.
items.access_note: Annotations on GitHub; MIMIC-CXR images need PhysioNet credentialing.

paper.label: Zambrano Chaves JM et al. arXiv 2024

items.name: VQA-RAD
items.description: 3,515 clinician-generated question–answer pairs about 315 radiology images, the first manually built medical VQA set.

paper.label: Lau JJ et al. Sci Data 2018;5:180251

items.name: OpenMedReason
items.description: Medical visual question answering with image-grounded reasoning traces and a rubric-scored test split.

items.name: WoundcareVQA
items.description: Multilingual wound-care visual question answering: 477 patient cases with images, queries and expert responses (MEDIQA-WV).

items.name: SynthVision
items.description: 119,000 synthetic medical images with VQA annotations for training multimodal models without patient data.
items.access_note: Direct download via GitHub / Hugging Face.

items.name: BIOMEDICA
items.description: 24 million image–caption pairs from 6 million PubMed Central open-access articles for training biomedical vision-language models.

paper.label: Lozano A et al. arXiv 2025

items.name: BiomedParseData
items.description: 3.4 million image–mask–label triples across nine imaging modalities used to train the BiomedParse segmentation foundation model.
items.access_note: Hugging Face account and acceptance of terms (gated).

paper.label: Zhao T et al. Nat Methods 2025;22:166

items.name: OpenPath (PLIP)
items.description: 208,414 pathology images paired with natural-language descriptions curated from medical Twitter, used to train the PLIP model.
items.access_note: Tweet IDs and links released; images retrieved per the authors' instructions.

paper.label: Huang Z et al. Nat Med 2023;29:2307

items.name: ECG-Grounding
items.description: 30,000 ECG instruction pairs with grounded, heartbeat-level interpretations for training explainable ECG language models.

items.name: OpenBiomedVid
items.description: 1,031 hours of biomedical video–text instruction data mined from educational videos, with SurgeryVideoQA and MIMICEchoQA benchmarks.
items.access_note: Code and data links on GitHub.

items.name: MedVidBench
items.description: 6,245 test samples benchmarking video-language models on surgical and medical video understanding.

items.name: MedConceptsQA
items.description: Open benchmark of questions on medical concepts (ICD-9/10, ATC and procedure codes) at three difficulty levels.

paper.label: Shoham OB, Rappoport N. arXiv 2024

items.name: EquityMedQA
items.description: Seven adversarial question sets for surfacing health-equity-related biases and harms in medical LLM answers.

paper.label: Pfohl SR et al. Nat Med 2024;30:3590

items.name: Med-HALT
items.description: Benchmark of reasoning and memory tests built from multinational medical exams for measuring hallucinations in LLMs.

paper.label: Pal A et al. CoNLL 2023

items.name: Red Teaming LLMs in Medicine
items.description: 382 clinician-crafted adversarial prompts with 1,146 ChatGPT responses labelled for safety, privacy, hallucination and bias.

items.name: Q-Pain
items.description: Clinical vignettes on pain management designed to measure social bias (race, gender) in medical QA systems.

items.name: CORAL
items.description: Expert-annotated oncology progress notes (breast and pancreatic cancer) for evaluating LLM information extraction.
items.access_note: Distributed via PhysioNet with credentialing + DUA.

paper.label: Sushil M et al. NEJM AI 2024

items.name: MeQSum
items.description: 1,000 consumer health questions paired with expert summaries for question summarisation.
items.access_note: Direct download from GitHub / Hugging Face.

paper.label: Ben Abacha A, Demner-Fushman D. ACL 2019

items.name: emrQA
items.description: ~1 million question–logical form and 400,000 question–answer pairs generated from n2c2 clinical notes for EMR question answering.
items.access_note: Generation scripts on GitHub; underlying notes require n2c2 DUA.

paper.label: Pampari A et al. EMNLP 2018

items.name: CodiEsp
items.description: 1,000 Spanish clinical case reports manually coded with ICD-10 diagnoses and procedures (CLEF eHealth 2020).

items.name: GPTNERMED
items.description: 9,845 synthetic German medical sentences with named-entity annotations generated by GPT (not expert-validated).

paper.label: Frei J, Kramer F. J Biomed Inform 2023;144:104478

items.name: BioRED
items.description: 600 PubMed abstracts annotated for biomedical entities and eight relation types for relation extraction.

paper.label: Luo L et al. Brief Bioinform 2022;23:bbac282

items.name: PGxCorpus
items.description: 945 sentences from 911 PubMed abstracts manually annotated with pharmacogenomic entities and relations.

paper.label: Legrand J et al. Sci Data 2020;7:3

items.name: BigBIO
items.description: Community library of 126+ biomedical NLP datasets in a uniform schema with Hugging Face loaders.
items.access_note: Open; some included datasets carry their own DUAs.

paper.label: Fries JA et al. NeurIPS 2022 Datasets & Benchmarks

items.name: BRIDGE-Open
items.description: Open-access subset of the BRIDGE benchmark: 55 multilingual clinical text tasks from real-world notes for evaluating LLMs.
items.access_note: Hugging Face account and acceptance of terms (gated).

items.name: MedInstruct-52k
items.description: 52,000 diverse medical instruction–response pairs generated with GPT-4 for instruction-tuning (AlpaCare).

paper.label: Zhang X et al. arXiv 2023

items.name: UltraMedical
items.description: 410,000 biomedical instructions with preference data, used to train the UltraMedical model family.
items.access_note: Direct download via GitHub / Hugging Face.

paper.label: Zhang K et al. NeurIPS 2024 Datasets & Benchmarks

items.name: II-Medical-Reasoning-SFT
items.description: ~2.2 million medical reasoning samples for supervised fine-tuning of reasoning LLMs.

items.name: Medical-Reasoning-SFT-GPT-OSS-120B
items.description: ~200,000 synthetic medical reasoning conversations generated with GPT-OSS-120B.

items.name: Llama2-MedTuned-Instructions
items.description: ~200,000 biomedical instruction samples (NER, RE, NLI, QA, classification) for instruction-tuning LLMs.

items.name: MediFlow
items.description: 2.5 million synthetic clinical instruction rows spanning many clinical text tasks and output formats.

items.name: HC4
items.description: Healthcare-focused pretraining corpus of ~65 billion tokens curated from web and literature sources.

items.name: NHS-LLM / OpenGPT datasets
items.description: 24,665 NHS-derived Q&A pairs, 2,354 conversations and 4,688 medical task pairs generated with the OpenGPT framework.

items.name: Dialogues of Delivery
items.description: Maternal-health questions and answers in four languages for evaluating multilingual health chatbots.

items.name: CSIRO Clinical Trials Search Collection
items.description: 204,855 clinical trials with relevance judgements for patient-to-trial matching and search evaluation.
items.access_note: Direct download from CSIRO Data Access Portal.

items.name: TREC Biomedical Tracks
items.description: Test collections from TREC Clinical Decision Support, Precision Medicine and Clinical Trials tracks (topics, documents, relevance judgements).

items.name: CTO (Clinical Trial Outcome) Dataset
items.description: ~479,000 clinical trials with automatically derived weak outcome labels for trial-outcome prediction.
items.access_note: Direct download from GitHub / Hugging Face.

items.name: FDA AI-CAD Device Database
items.description: Curated list of FDA clearances for AI-based image-interpretation (CAD) devices with evidence characteristics.
